an9.20:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
an9.20:1.2: athakho anāthapiṇḍiko gahapati yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho anāthapiṇḍikaṃ gahapatiṃ bhagavā etadavoca
an9.20:2.1: api nu te gahapati kule dānaṃ diyyatīti.
an9.20:2.4: lūkhaṃ vāpi gahapati dānaṃ deti paṇītaṃ vā
an9.20:2.5: tañca asakkaccaṃ deti apacittiṃ katvā deti asahatthā deti apaviṭṭhaṃ deti anāgamanadiṭṭhiko deti
an9.20:2.6: yattha yattha tassa tassa dānassa vipāko nibbattati na uḷārāya bhattabhogāya cittaṃ namati na uḷārāya vatthabhogāya cittaṃ namati na uḷārāya yānabhogāya cittaṃ namati na uḷāresu pañcasu kāmaguṇesu bhogāya cittaṃ namati
an9.20:2.7: yepissa te honti puttāti vā dārāti vā dāsāti vā pessāti vā kammakarāti vā tepi na sussusanti na sotaṃ odahanti aññācittaṃ upaṭṭhapenti
an9.20:2.9: evañcetaṃ gahapati hoti asakkaccakatānaṃ kammānaṃ vipāko

an9.20:3.6: evañcetaṃ gahapati hoti sakkaccakatānaṃ kammānaṃ vipāko.
an9.20:4.1: bhūtapubbaṃ gahapati velāmo nāma brāhmaṇo ahosi
an9.20:4.3: caturāsīti suvaṇṇapāṭisahassāni adāsi rūpiyapūrāni caturāsīti rūpiyapāṭisahassāni adāsi suvaṇṇapūrāni caturāsīti kaṃsapāṭisahassāni adāsi hiraññapūrāni caturāsīti hatthisahassāni adāsi sovaṇṇālaṅkārāni sovaṇṇaddhajāni hemajālapaṭicchannāni caturāsīti rathasahassāni adāsi sīhacammaparivārāni byagghacammaparivārāni dipicammaparivārāni paṇḍukambalaparivārāni sovaṇṇālaṅkārāni sovaṇṇaddhajāni hemajālapaṭicchannāni caturāsīti dhenusahassāni adāsi dukulasaṇṭhanāni kaṃsūpadhāraṇāni caturāsīti kaññāsahassāni adāsi āmuttamaṇikuṇḍalāyo caturāsīti pallaṅkasahassāni adāsi gonakatthatāni paṭikatthatāni paṭalikatthatāni kadalimigapavarapaccattharaṇāni sauttaracchadāni ubhatolohitakūpadhānāni caturāsīti vatthakoṭisahassāni adāsi khomasukhumānaṃ koseyyasukhumānaṃ kappāsikasukhumānaṃ ko pana vādo annassa pānassa khajjassa bhojanassa lepanassa seyyassa najjo maññe visandanti
an9.20:5.1: siyā kho pana te gahapati evamassa
an9.20:5.2: añño na tena samayena velāmo brāhmaṇo ahosi so taṃ dānaṃ adāsi mahādānanti
an9.20:5.3: na kho panetaṃ gahapati evaṃ daṭṭhabbaṃ
an9.20:5.4: ahaṃ tena samayena velāmo brāhmaṇo ahosiṃ
an9.20:5.6: tasmiṃ kho pana gahapati dāne na koci dakkhiṇeyyo ahosi na taṃ koci dakkhiṇaṃ visodheti
an9.20:6.1: yaṃ gahapati velāmo brāhmaṇo dānaṃ adāsi mahādānaṃ yo cekaṃ diṭṭhisampannaṃ bhojeyya idaṃ tato mahapphalataraṃ
an9.20:7.1: yo ca sataṃ diṭṭhisampannānaṃ bhojeyya yo cekaṃ sakadāgāmiṃ bhojeyya …pe…
an9.20:8.1: yo ca sataṃ sakadāgāmīnaṃ bhojeyya yo cekaṃ anāgāmiṃ bhojeyya
an9.20:8.2: yo ca sataṃ anāgāmīnaṃ bhojeyya yo cekaṃ arahantaṃ bhojeyya
an9.20:8.3: yo ca sataṃ arahantānaṃ bhojeyya yo cekaṃ paccekabuddhaṃ bhojeyya
an9.20:8.4: yo ca sataṃ paccekabuddhānaṃ bhojeyya yo ca tathāgataṃ arahantaṃ sammāsambuddhaṃ bhojeyya
an9.20:8.6: yo ca cātuddisaṃ saṅghaṃ uddissa vihāraṃ kārāpeyya
an9.20:8.7: yo ca pasannacitto buddhañca dhammañca saṅghañca saraṇaṃ gaccheyya
an9.20:8.9: pāṇātipātā veramaṇī adinnādānā veramaṇī kāmesu micchācārā veramaṇī musāvādā veramaṇī surāmerayamajjapamādaṭṭhānā veramaṇī yo ca pasannacitto sikkhāpadāni samādiyeyya pāṇātipātā veramaṇī …pa… surāmerayamajjapamādaṭṭhānā veramaṇī yo ca antamaso gaddūhanamattampi mettacittaṃ bhāveyya idaṃ tato mahapphalataraṃ
an9.20:9.1: yañca gahapati velāmo brāhmaṇo dānaṃ adāsi mahādānaṃ yo cekaṃ diṭṭhisampannaṃ bhojeyya
an9.20:9.2: yo ca sataṃ diṭṭhisampannānaṃ bhojeyya yo cekaṃ sakadāgāmiṃ bhojeyya
an9.20:9.3: yo ca sataṃ sakadāgāmīnaṃ bhojeyyayo cekaṃ anāgāmiṃ bhojeyya
an9.20:9.4: yo ca sataṃ anāgāmīnaṃ bhojeyya yo cekaṃ arahantaṃ bhojeyya
an9.20:9.5: yo ca sataṃ arahantānaṃ bhojeyya yo cekaṃ paccekabuddhaṃ bhojeyya
an9.20:9.6: yo ca sataṃ paccekabuddhānaṃ bhojeyya yo ca tathāgataṃ arahantaṃ sammāsambuddhaṃ bhojeyya
an9.20:9.7: yo ca sataṃ buddhappamukhaṃ bhikkhusaṅghaṃ bhojeyya yo ca cātuddisaṃ saṅghaṃ uddissa vihāraṃ kārāpeyya
an9.20:9.8: yo ca pasannacitto buddhañca dhammañca saṅghañca saraṇaṃ gaccheyya yo ca pasannacitto sikkhāpadāni samādiyeyya
an9.20:9.9: pāṇātipātā veramaṇī …pe… surāmerayamajjapamādaṭṭhānā veramaṇī yo ca antamaso gaddūhanamattampi mettacittaṃ bhāveyya yo ca accharāsaṅghātamattampi aniccasaññaṃ bhāveyya idaṃ tato mahapphalataranti.
